column1: Can I get an exclusive formula?

Yes — at our factory, exclusive formulas are a standard service, and most larger brands ask for one. There are three kinds: an exclusive formula (the same formula is never made for another brand), an exclusive variant (your version of a formula is yours alone), and market or channel exclusivity (the formula is only supplied to you in your market or channel). Differentiation is straightforward: adjusting equivalent ingredients creates a different formula with the same performance — that is how we deliver exclusivity in practice. That is the charm of skincare. Terms, including any link to MOQ or a development fee, are confirmed per order.
column2: Ya, di pabrik kami, rumus eksklusif adalah layanan standar, dan merek yang paling besar meminta satu. Ada tiga jenis: rumus eksklusif (rumus yang sama tidak pernah dibuat untuk merek lain), suatu varian eksklusif (versi rumus khusus Anda adalah Anda sendiri), dan pasar atau saluran eksklusif (rumus hanya disediakan untuk Anda di pasar atau saluran). Diferensiasi adalah langsung: menyesuaikan bahan-bahan yang setara menciptakan rumus yang berbeda dengan kinerja yang sama adalah bagaimana kita memberikan eksklusifitas dalam praktek. Itulah pesona perawatan kulit. Istilah, termasuk setiap link ke MOQ atau biaya pengembangan, dikonfirmasi per pesanan.

column1: In six steps: consultation, formula and sampling, pilot and approval, mass production, QC and testing, packaging and delivery. You approve the formula and the packaging before bulk production starts. Every order is sampled and customised to your brand’s requirements — there are no standard off-the-shelf products. Most orders are semi-custom: start from a proven formula in our 10,000+ library, then adjust it to your brand. column1: ISO 22716 is the international Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) standard for cosmetics: it means production, hygiene, quality control and documentation follow that standard. It supports your market registration — but it does not by itself put your product on the market.
column2: ISO 22716 adalah standar internasional Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) untuk kosmetik: artinya produksi, kebersihan, kontrol kualitas, dan dokumentasi mengikuti standar tersebut. Standar ini mendukung pendaftaran pasar Anda — tetapi tidak dengan sendirinya memasarkan produk Anda.

column1: It covers how a cosmetics factory works: the people and training, the premises and equipment, raw materials and packaging, production and quality control, the handling of finished products, and the records that prove what was done. In short, it is a system for making the same product, the same way, every time — and for proving it.
column2: Ini mencakup bagaimana pabrik kosmetik bekerja: orang-orang dan pelatihan, tempat dan peralatan, bahan baku dan kemasan, produksi dan kontrol kualitas, penanganan produk selesai, dan catatan yang membuktikan apa yang dilakukan. Singkatnya, itu adalah sistem untuk membuat produk yang sama, dengan cara yang sama, setiap kali dan untuk membuktikannya.

column1: How does sampling work before bulk production? You approve a sample before 500–1,000 units are made: send your brief, receive a sample, give feedback, adjust if needed, and only the confirmed sample goes to bulk.

column1: How do you choose a private label serum formula? Start with your market and your hero ingredient, not a long ingredient list. Ready formula or custom formula, Vitamin C, Niacinamide, Hyaluronic Acid or Peptide — what to decide, and what to send with your brief.

column1: What does ISO 22716 certification mean for your market? It is the international cosmetics GMP standard. Amy Skin OEM's verified claim is SGS ISO 22716 — it supports your market registration, but does not replace it.
